passages.title: Categories

passages.title: Animae among categories
passages.note: isAn is the primitive predicate. AN bundles a category with a witness; structural recognition as a groupoid belongs later.

passages.title: Product parameter notation
passages.note: The code uses projection functors from a product parameter. This is an association with the underlying operations, not a separate formal syntax of contexts.
